source: World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal CMIP6-x0.25 multi-model ensemble, median statistic
statistic: median across ensemble; country values averaged equally within app zones

variables.txx: Annual maximum of daily maximum temperature (°C), used only as a delta proxy for the site’s warm-season P99.
variables.hurs: Monthly mean near-surface relative humidity (%); warm-season month mean deltas adjust the site’s hot-day RH estimate.
variables.method: Changes are applied to the NASA POWER 1991-2020 local hot-day estimates to preserve their local baseline while using CMIP6 changes.
